training_source: Public SER head trained on nine named corpora including JL-Corpus and Emozionalmente; Whisper-v3 pretraining incompletely disclosed; author nEMO threshold calibration is counted as seen development use, although its thresholds are not applied here

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actress was asked to portray, from the last word of the file name (`angry`, `disgust`, `fear`, `happy`, `neutral`, `ps` for pleasant surprise, `sad`)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, surprised, sad)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
